An Upstash Alternative for Always-On Apps (Managed Redis Next to Your Code)

Quick thread 🧵
If you run serverless functions or edge code and want an HTTP Redis you pay for by the request, Upstash is a great fit and you should probably keep it.
If you've got an always-on app on a persistent server and want a low-latency Redis in the same account, right next to your app, at a price you can forecast, that's the alternative here.

On Kloudbean, Redis is one of the managed database engines: one click to launch, automatic backups, IP allow-listing so only your app server can connect, the standard Redis protocol, and you own the data.
